We are looking for health, wellness and lifestyle creators to introduce BIO N:OV to their audience. You earn 15–25% commission on every sale made through your unique link, tracked automatically.

Accepted affiliates receive a free box to try before they post.

settings.title: 1. Apply
settings.body: Send us your handle and audience. We review every application by hand — no follower minimum, but your audience should genuinely care about health.

settings.title: 2. Try it
settings.body: Accepted affiliates get a free box shipped to them. We would rather you post after you have actually taken it.

settings.title: 3. Share your link
settings.body: You get a unique tracking link and a creative pack — product shots, brand colours and pre-cleared copy that stays inside health-advertising rules.

settings.title: 4. Get paid
settings.body: Commission on every tracked sale, paid monthly. Clicks, conversions and payouts are all visible in your dashboard.

settings.text:
What you can and cannot say

BIO N:OV is a dietary supplement, not a medicine. Affiliates must not claim it cures, treats, prevents or diagnoses any disease, must not promise specific results, and must not tell anyone to stop taking prescribed medication.

Use supportive language — "supports", "helps maintain", "promotes" — and disclose the partnership on every post, as required in your market. We will send you the full creative guidelines when you are accepted.
